description: List support tickets raised from chat, with status, priority and the visitor's details. Needs the Standard plan or higher.

limit.description: How many tickets to return (1-100, default 25).

status.description: Only tickets with this status, for example open or resolved.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: list_tickets
title: List support tickets
